name: Exposure
note: Linear-light EV gain. 8-bit source, so recovery is limited to existing data.

name: Dynamic Range
note: Estimated from 8-bit percentiles, not sensor dynamic range.

name: Histogram
note: 256-bin luma and RGB.

name: Clipping
note: Measured %, plus on-canvas warning overlay.

name: Contrast
note: Power curve about 0.18 linear grey.

name: Midtones
note: No dedicated midtone slider; handled via contrast and curve.

name: Tone Curve
note: Monotone cubic master curve with a draggable point editor and presets.

name: Zebra Patterns
note: Solid clip warning, not animated zebra.

name: Color Temperature
note: Per-channel gain approximation, not a true Kelvin model.

name: Tint
note: Per-channel gain approximation, not a true Kelvin model.

name: White Balance
note: Auto estimate from neutral midtones plus manual sliders.

name: HSL / HSV
note: 8-band hue/sat/luminance.

name: Color Grading
note: Split toning plus HSL, curve and temperature. No lift/gamma/gain wheels, no LUT import.

name: Split Toning
note: Shadow and highlight tint (hue + amount) with a balance control. Chroma offsets with no net luminance change; no midtone wheel.

name: Color Cast
note: Detected from neutral-region bias.

name: Chromatic Aberration
note: Manual lateral CA correction only (radial R/B scaling). No auto-detection, no purple fringe or axial CA.

name: Defringe
note: Lateral chromatic aberration slider only. No purple or green fringe colour removal along edges.

name: Color Space
full: Color Space (sRGB, Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, DCI-P3)

name: 3D LUT
note: Grade tab imports .cube files (1D or 3D, DOMAIN supported) and applies them in the shader with trilinear interpolation; included in exports.

name: White Balance Target / Gray Card Calibration
full: White Balance Target / Gray Card Calibration

name: Sharpness / Acutance
note: Neighbourhood unsharp in shader.

name: Unsharp Mask
note: Neighbourhood unsharp in shader.

name: Clarity
note: Large-radius local contrast approximation, midtone weighted.

name: Texture
note: Small-radius detail approximation.

name: Dehaze
note: Small-window dark-channel estimate, no guided-filter refinement. Can amplify noise and create halos at strong edges.

name: Luminance Noise
note: Light 8-tap edge-aware luma and chroma smoothing. Not a denoising model.

name: Chrominance Noise
note: Light 8-tap edge-aware luma and chroma smoothing. Not a denoising model.

name: Noise Reduction
note: Light 8-tap edge-aware luma and chroma smoothing. Not a denoising model.

name: High-ISO Grain vs. Artificial Grain
note: Artificial grain only.

name: Lens Distortion
note: Single-coefficient radial model, manual. No lens profiles.

name: Lens Profile Corrections
note: Manual distortion, vignette and chromatic aberration sliders. No lens database or automatic profiles.

name: Vignetting
note: Creative vignette only. No lens-profile correction.

name: Focus Stacking
note: Needs several aligned frames merged together. Lumen edits one photo at a time.

name: Aspect Ratio
note: Crop rectangle; presets in UI.

name: Rule of Thirds Overlay
note: Overlay in editor.

name: Straighten / Leveling
note: Auto-inscribed zoom hides rotated edges.

name: Keystone Correction
note: Manual vertical/horizontal keystone sliders. No auto-upright and no four-point homography.

name: Perspective Correction
note: Manual vertical/horizontal keystone sliders. No auto-upright and no four-point homography.

name: Upright / Transform Tools
note: Manual vertical and horizontal perspective sliders and straighten. No automatic Upright (line detection).

name: Canvas Size vs. Image Size
note: Crop rectangle; presets in UI.

name: Resolution
note: Export ladder: original, 360p to 8K by long edge, or custom. Enlarging adds no new detail.

name: Resampling / Interpolation
note: Lanczos-3 for export resizing (up and down). No bicubic/bilinear choice.

name: Spot Healing
note: Click a blemish: Lumen searches nearby for the best-matching clean source ring, then blends it in with harmonic colour matching. Tested against ground truth. No texture synthesis for large areas.

name: Clone Stamp
note: Set a source, then stamp with a soft edge and fixed offset. Exact copy. Single source (no source palette, no pressure, no rotate/scale).

name: Content-Aware Fill / Move / Patch
note: Fill only: exemplar-based inpainting from the same photo. No Move or Patch tools.

name: Inpainting / Generative Fill
note: Classical exemplar inpainting only. No generative model, so it cannot invent new content.

name: Dodge and Burn
note: Achievable manually: brush mask + local exposure. No dedicated tool or automatic frequency separation.

name: Blemish Removal
note: Spot removal handles small blemishes. No skin-aware or frequency-separation retouching.

name: Object Removal
note: Paint over the object; it is filled with patches copied from the rest of the photo. Large masks are solved at reduced resolution and may look repetitive or soft.

name: Adjustment Layers
note: Two parametric layers (AI recipe and manual). Not arbitrary user layers.

name: Layer Masks
note: Every local layer has its own mask; no pixel layers.

name: Luminosity Masks
note: Luminance range with soft edges, usable alone or intersected with another mask. No zone presets.

name: Color Range Mask
note: Hue range + minimum saturation. Usable alone or intersected.

name: Radial Filter / Radial Gradient Mask
note: Elliptical mask with feather, invert, density. Draggable handles.

name: Linear Gradient Mask
note: Two-point gradient mask with feather, invert, density.

name: Brush Tool
full: Brush Tool (Size, Hardness, Flow, Opacity, Smoothing)
note: Size, feather, flow, erase. No stroke smoothing, pressure or edge-aware snapping.

name: Feathering
note: Feather control per mask. No post-hoc blur of arbitrary selections.

name: Edge Refinement / Refine Edge / Select and Mask
full: Edge Refinement / Refine Edge / Select and Mask
note: Masks have feather, invert and range limits. No AI edge detection or hair refinement.

name: Global Adjustments vs. Local Adjustments
note: Global only until masking phase.

name: Blending Modes
